title: "FIRE frequency and FiberHMM footprint density at active and Low-DNase cCREs"
author: "Crystal Shan"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  fig.path = file.path(tempdir(), "cre-density-figures/"))
```

Inputs, all pooled over the 31 LCL samples (chr1-22, X, Y):

- `fire_freq.<set>.tsv` from `cre_fire_freq_dnase.Rmd`
- `footprints/cre_footprint_summary.tsv.gz` from `bash cre_footprint_density.sh footprints`
  (`cre_summary/count_cre_footprints.R`)

Both use the same denominator, `n_covered`: fibers with one aligned block covering
the whole cCRE (no deletion inside it) and a FiberHMM v2 record on the chromosome,
open or closed.

- FIRE frequency = fibers with >= 1 FIRE element overlapping the cCRE / `n_covered`
- Footprints per covered fiber = 10-80 bp FiberHMM footprints inside a FIRE element
  of an open fiber (FIRE element covering >= 50% of the cCRE) that touch the cCRE /
  `n_covered`; closed fibers count 0
- Footprints per covered fiber per 100 bp = the above x 100 / cCRE length
- % of cCRE bases footprinted = footprinted cCRE bases (per fiber, overlaps counted
  once) / (`n_covered` x cCRE length)

cCREs with >= 10 covered fibers are summarised; outputs go to `footprints/summary/`.

```{r load}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(data.table); library(ggplot2)})

out_root <- Sys.getenv("CRE_ACCESS_ROOT", "/project/spott/cshan/fiber-seq/LCL_project/CRE_access")
fp_dir <- file.path(out_root, "footprints")
out_dir <- file.path(fp_dir, "summary")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
sets <- c("active_cre", "low_dnase_cre")
min_covered <- 10

cre <- fread(file.path(fp_dir, "cres.tsv.gz"))
fp <- fread(file.path(fp_dir, "cre_footprint_summary.tsv.gz"),
            select = c("CRE_ID", "width", "n_covered", "n_footprints", "footprints_per_fiber", "pct_bases_footprinted"))
ff <- rbindlist(lapply(sets, function(s)
  fread(file.path(out_root, sprintf("fire_freq.%s.tsv", s)), select = c("id", "n_reads", "n_fire"))))
setnames(ff, "id", "CRE_ID")

for (name in c("cre", "fp", "ff")) {
  ids <- get(name)$CRE_ID
  if (anyNA(ids) || anyDuplicated(ids))
    stop(name, ": missing or duplicate CRE_ID values; each input must have one row per cCRE.")
}
coverage <- rbindlist(lapply(c("fp", "ff"), function(name) {
  ids <- get(name)$CRE_ID
  data.table(input = name, missing = sum(!cre$CRE_ID %in% ids),
             unexpected = sum(!ids %in% cre$CRE_ID))
}))
if (any(coverage$missing > 0L | coverage$unexpected > 0L)) {
  print(coverage)
  stop("Input CRE IDs do not match cres.tsv.gz.")
}
d <- merge(merge(cre, fp, by = "CRE_ID"), ff, by = "CRE_ID")
stopifnot(nrow(d) == nrow(cre), nrow(d) == nrow(fp), nrow(d) == nrow(ff),
          identical(as.integer(d$n_reads), as.integer(d$n_covered)))
d[, `:=`(fire_freq = n_fire / n_covered, fp_per_100bp = 100 * footprints_per_fiber / width)]
cat(sprintf("cCREs: %d | n_reads == n_covered for all | >= %d covered fibers: %d\n",
            nrow(d), min_covered, d[n_covered >= min_covered, .N]))
```

```{r summary_table}
metrics <- c(fire_freq = "FIRE frequency",
             footprints_per_fiber = "Footprints per covered fiber",
             fp_per_100bp = "Footprints per covered fiber per 100 bp",
             pct_bases_footprinted = "% of cCRE bases footprinted")
classes <- c("PLS", "pELS", "dELS", "CA-H3K4me3", "CA-CTCF", "CA-TF", "CA-only")
groups <- c("Low-DNase", "active (all)", classes)

ok <- d[n_covered >= min_covered]
dd <- rbind(ok[set == "low_dnase_cre"][, group := "Low-DNase"],
            ok[set == "active_cre"][, group := "active (all)"],
            ok[set == "active_cre"][, group := class])
dd[, group := factor(group, levels = groups)]
long <- melt(dd, id.vars = c("group", "set"), measure.vars = names(metrics), variable.name = "metric")
long[, metric := factor(metrics[as.character(metric)], levels = metrics)]

tab <- long[, .(n_cCREs = .N, median = median(value), mean = mean(value)), by = .(group, metric)][order(metric, group)]
tab_wide <- dcast(tab, group + n_cCREs ~ metric, value.var = c("median", "mean"))
fwrite(tab_wide, file.path(out_dir, "fire_footprint_density_summary.tsv"), sep = "\t")
print(tab[, .(group, metric, n_cCREs, median = signif(median, 3), mean = signif(mean, 3))], row.names = FALSE)
```

## Boxplots

Boxes are the 25th-75th percentiles with the median; whiskers reach the most extreme
cCRE within 1.5 x IQR (cCREs beyond them are not drawn); x = mean.

```{r boxplots, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 4.8}
bx <- long[, {
  q <- quantile(value, c(.25, .5, .75), names = FALSE); iqr <- q[3] - q[1]
  .(lower = q[1], middle = q[2], upper = q[3],
    ymin = min(value[value >= q[1] - 1.5 * iqr]), ymax = max(value[value <= q[3] + 1.5 * iqr]),
    mean = mean(value))
}, by = .(group, set, metric)]
p <- ggplot(bx, aes(group, fill = set)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(ymin = ymin, lower = lower, middle = middle, upper = upper, ymax = ymax),
               stat = "identity", width = 0.65, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean), shape = 4, size = 1.6) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(active_cre = "#2a78d6", low_dnase_cre = "#eb6834"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "FIRE frequency and FiberHMM footprint density per cCRE",
       subtitle = sprintf("cCREs with >= %d covered fibers, pooled over 31 samples",
                          min_covered)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), strip.background = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "fire_footprint_density_boxplots.pdf"), p, width = 13, height = 4.8)
p
```
